SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS unique_subjects,
  SUM(COALESCE(d.FEE, 0)) AS total_fees_collected,
  MIN(
    CASE
      WHEN s.SESSION_START_TIME IS NOT NULL AND s.SESSION_END_TIME IS NOT NULL

      THEN
        CASE
          WHEN TIME_TO_SEC(TIMEDIFF(STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p'), STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p'))) < 0
          THEN TIME_TO_SEC(TIMEDIFF(ADDTIME(STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p'), '24:00:00'), STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p')))
          ELSE TIME_TO_SEC(TIMEDIFF(STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p'), STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p')))
        END
    END
  ) / 60 AS shortest_session_length_minutes,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN s.SESSION_START_TIME IS NOT NULL AND s.SESSION_END_TIME IS NOT NULL
           AND STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p') IS NOT NULL
           AND STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p') IS NOT NULL
      THEN
        CASE
          WHEN TIME_TO_SEC(TIMEDIFF(STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p'), STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p'))) < 0
          THEN TIME_TO_SEC(TIMEDIFF(ADDTIME(STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p'), '24:00:00'), STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p')))
          ELSE TIME_TO_SEC(TIMEDIFF(STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p'), STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p')))
        END
    END
  ) / 60 AS longest_session_length_minutes
FROM IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION s
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d
  ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
LEFT JOIN BUILDINGS b
  ON b.BUILDING_NUMBER = s.SESSION_LOCATION
WHERE b.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NULL;

SELECT
  sc.SCHOOL_CODE,
  sc.SCHOOL_NAME,
  d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
  cd.COURSE_LEVEL,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cd.COURSE) AS total_courses,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' THEN cd.COURSE END) AS degree_granting_courses
FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d
  ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cd.DEPARTMENT
JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc
  ON sc.SUBJECT_CODE = cd.COURSE
GROUP BY
  sc.SCHOOL_CODE,
  sc.SCHOOL_NAME,
  d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
  cd.COURSE_LEVEL
ORDER BY
  sc.SCHOOL_NAME,
  d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
  cd.COURSE_LEVEL;

WITH dept_school AS (
  SELECT
    d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    MAX(sc.SCHOOL_CODE) AS SCHOOL_CODE,
    MAX(sc.SCHOOL_NAME) AS SCHOOL_NAME
  FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d
  LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd
    ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  LEFT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc
    ON sc.SUBJECT_CODE = cd.COURSE
  GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
),
phone_counts AS (
  SELECT
    ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER) AS distinct_phone_numbers
  FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad
  GROUP BY ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE
),
course_level_counts AS (
  SELECT
    cd.DEPARTMENT AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ug_courses,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS grad_courses
  FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd
  GROUP BY cd.DEPARTMENT
)
SELECT
  ds.SCHOOL_CODE,
  ds.SCHOOL_NAME,
  d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
  COALESCE(pc.distinct_phone_numbers, 0) AS distinct_phone_numbers,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(clc.ug_courses, 0) > COALESCE(clc.grad_courses, 0) THEN 'Undergraduate'
    WHEN COALESCE(clc.grad_courses, 0) > COALESCE(clc.ug_courses, 0) THEN 'Graduate'
    WHEN COALESCE(clc.ug_courses, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(clc.grad_courses, 0) = 0 THEN 'Unknown'
    ELSE 'Tie'
  END AS most_courses_level
FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d
LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad
  ON ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN dept_school ds
  ON ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN phone_counts pc
  ON pc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN course_level_counts clc
  ON clc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
ORDER BY
  ds.SCHOOL_NAME,
  ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  d.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

SELECT

  COUNT(DISTINCT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS department_count

JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd

JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd

    ON su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
),
agg_space AS (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    BUILDING_NAME,
    BUILDING_COMPONENT,
    SUM(COALESCE(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, 0)) AS total_square_footage,
    COUNT(DISTINCT FLOOR_KEY) AS number_of_floors,
    COUNT(DISTINCT BUILDING_ROOM) AS number_of_rooms,
    COUNT(DISTINCT FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS facility_organizations
  FROM base
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY, BUILDING_NAME, BUILDING_COMPONENT
),
dept_map AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    BUILDING_COMPONENT,
    DLC_KEY
  FROM base
  WHERE DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL
),
agg_supervisors AS (
  SELECT
    dm.BUILDING_KEY,
    dm.BUILDING_COMPONENT,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ssu.MIT_ID) AS total_supervisors,
    SUM(COALESCE(ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, 0)) AS total_supervisees
  FROM dept_map dm
  JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ssu
    ON ssu.DEPT_NAMES = dm.DLC_KEY
  GROUP BY dm.BUILDING_KEY, dm.BUILDING_COMPONENT
)
SELECT
  a.BUILDING_KEY,
  a.BUILDING_NAME,
  a.BUILDING_COMPONENT,
  a.total_square_footage,
  a.number_of_floors,
  a.number_of_rooms,
  a.facility_organizations,
  COALESCE(s.total_supervisors, 0) AS total_supervisors,
  COALESCE(s.total_supervisees, 0) AS total_supervisees
FROM agg_space a
LEFT JOIN agg_supervisors s
  ON s.BUILDING_KEY = a.BUILDING_KEY
 AND s.BUILDING_COMPONENT = a.BUILDING_COMPONENT
ORDER BY a.BUILDING_NAME, a.BUILDING_COMPONENT;

WITH dlc_space AS (
  SELECT
    su.DLC_KEY,
    su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY,
    sd.BUILDING_KEY,
    sd.FLOOR_KEY,
    sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE
  FROM SPACE_UNIT su
  JOIN SPACE_DETAIL sd
    ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
),
dlc_agg_space AS (
  SELECT
    ds.DLC_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sf.FLOOR) AS total_floors,
    SUM(ds.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS total_square_footage,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ds.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS number_of_facilities,
    SUM(DISTINCT CAST(NULLIF(fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT, '') AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS combined_building_height
  FROM dlc_space ds
  LEFT JOIN SPACE_FLOOR sf
    ON sf.FLOOR_KEY = ds.FLOOR_KEY
  LEFT JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb
    ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ds.BUILDING_KEY
  GROUP BY ds.DLC_KEY
),
dlc_agg_supervisors AS (
  SELECT
    ssu.DEPT_NAMES AS DLC_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ssu.MIT_ID) AS number_of_supervisors,
    SUM(ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS total_supervisees
  FROM SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ssu
  GROUP BY ssu.DEPT_NAMES
)
SELECT
  fo.DLC_KEY,
  fo.DLC_NAME,
  COALESCE(das.total_floors, 0) AS total_floors,
  COALESCE(das.total_square_footage, 0) AS total_square_footage,
  COALESCE(das.number_of_facilities, 0) AS number_of_facilities,
  COALESCE(dsup.number_of_supervisors, 0) AS number_of_supervisors,
  COALESCE(dsup.total_supervisees, 0) AS total_supervisees,
  COALESCE(das.combined_building_height, 0) AS combined_building_height
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT DLC_KEY, DLC_NAME
  FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION
  WHERE DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL
) fo
LEFT JOIN dlc_agg_space das
  ON das.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY
LEFT JOIN dlc_agg_supervisors dsup
  ON dsup.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY
ORDER BY fo.DLC_KEY;

SELECT
  tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subjects_offered_count,
  SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_students_enrolled,
  MIN(tm.RENTAL_NEW_PRICE) AS lowest_rental_new_price,
  MAX(tm.RENTAL_NEW_PRICE) AS highest_rental_new_price
FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
LEFT JOIN TIP_DETAIL td
  ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
LEFT JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
  ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
GROUP BY
  tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
ORDER BY
  tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

SELECT
  ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  ccs.TERM_CODE,
  so.HGN_CODE,
  ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  ed.FULL_NAME AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
  ed.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_EMAIL,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ccs.SUBJECT_ID) AS COURSES_OFFERED_COUNT,
  AVG(ccs.TOTAL_UNITS) AS AVG_TOTAL_UNITS
FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at
JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs
  ON ccs.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so
  ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID
LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ed
  ON ed.MIT_ID = so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
WHERE at.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y'
GROUP BY
  ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  ccs.TERM_CODE,
  so.HGN_CODE,
  ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  ed.FULL_NAME,
  ed.EMAIL_ADDRESS
ORDER BY
  ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  ccs.TERM_CODE,
  ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  ed.FULL_NAME,
  so.HGN_CODE;

SELECT
  d.ACTIVITY_TITLE,
  c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AS CATEGORY_NAME,
  s.SESSION_TITLE,
  s.SESSION_START_TIME,
  s.SESSION_END_TIME,
  sp.SPONSOR_NAME,
  COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS SESSION_COUNT
FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c
  ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION s
  ON s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR sp
  ON sp.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
ORDER BY
  d.ACTIVITY_TITLE,
  s.SESSION_SEQUENCE;

SELECT
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
  sc.SUBJECT_CODE AS subject_code,
  sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC AS subject_code_description,
  CASE
    WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN cd.GRADUATE_LEVEL IS NOT NULL AND cd.GRADUATE_LEVEL <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
      THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
  END AS is_graduate_level,
  dc.total_courses_offered
FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d
JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd
  ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc
  ON sc.COURSE_NUMBER = cd.COURSE
JOIN (
  SELECT
    cd2.DEPARTMENT AS department_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sc2.COURSE_NUMBER) AS total_courses_offered
  FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd2
  JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc2
    ON sc2.COURSE_NUMBER = cd2.COURSE
  GROUP BY cd2.DEPARTMENT
) dc
  ON dc.department_code = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
GROUP BY
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  sc.SUBJECT_CODE,
  sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC,
  dc.total_courses_offered
ORDER BY
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  sc.SUBJECT_CODE;

SELECT
  t.TERM_CODE,
  t.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END), 'N') AS IS_CURRENT_TERM,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS DISTINCT_CIS_SUBJECTS_OFFERED
FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t
LEFT JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p
  ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c
  ON c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
GROUP BY
  t.TERM_CODE,
  t.TERM_DESCRIPTION
ORDER BY
  t.TERM_CODE;

SELECT
  tm.AUTHOR AS author,
  sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name,
  tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status,
  SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_records,
  COUNT(DISTINCT td.SUBJECT_ID) AS distinct_courses
FROM TIP_DETAIL td
JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms
  ON tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
  ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd
  ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
  ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
GROUP BY
  tm.AUTHOR,
  sd.SCHOOL_NAME,
  tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS
ORDER BY
  tm.AUTHOR,
  sd.SCHOOL_NAME,
  tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS;

SELECT
    tso.COURSE_NUMBER AS course_number,
    tso.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title,
    tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status,
    SUM(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS total_new_shelf_price,
    MIN(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS lowest_new_shelf_price,
    MAX(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS highest_new_shelf_price,
    SUM(tm.USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS total_used_shelf_price,
    MIN(tm.USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS lowest_used_shelf_price,
    MAX(tm.USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS highest_used_shelf_price,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) AS schools_offering_course,
    COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS different_materials_included
FROM TIP_DETAIL td
JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
    ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
    ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms
    ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
GROUP BY
    tso.COURSE_NUMBER,
    tso.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS
ORDER BY
    tso.COURSE_NUMBER,
    tso.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS;

SELECT
  tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status,
  COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_materials,
  COUNT(DISTINCT td.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_covered,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sd.SCHOOL_NAME) AS num_schools_involved,
  MAX(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(tm.YEAR), '') AS UNSIGNED)) AS latest_publication_year
FROM TIP_DETAIL td
JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
  ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms
  ON tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
  ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd
  ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
GROUP BY
  tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS
ORDER BY
  num_materials DESC,
  material_status;

SELECT
  at.TERM_CODE,
  at.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  at.IS_CURRENT_TERM,
  COUNT(DISTINCT tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS courses_offered,
  COUNT(DISTINCT tm.ISBN) AS different_materials_used,
  MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS lowest_student_enrollment,
  MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS highest_student_enrollment,
  COUNT(DISTINCT tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) AS schools_offering,
  COALESCE(SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT), 0) AS total_records
FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at
LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
  ON at.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN TIP_DETAIL td
  ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
LEFT JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
  ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
LEFT JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms
  ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
GROUP BY
  at.TERM_CODE,
  at.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  at.IS_CURRENT_TERM
ORDER BY
  at.TERM_CODE;

SELECT
  b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS AS street_address,
  a.CITY AS city,
  a.STATE AS state,
  o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS hr_department_name,
  CAST(fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS building_height,
  b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS assignable_square_footage,
  SUM(CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS total_room_square_footage,
  AVG(CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS average_room_size
FROM BUILDINGS b
JOIN FAC_BUILDING fb
  ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
JOIN FAC_ROOMS r
  ON r.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN FAC_ORGANIZATION o
  ON o.ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.ORGANIZATION_KEY
LEFT JOIN FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS a
  ON a.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
 AND a.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
GROUP BY
  b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
  a.CITY,
  a.STATE,
  o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  CAST(fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT AS DECIMAL(10,2)),
  b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE
ORDER BY
  b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE DESC,
  total_room_square_footage DESC;

SELECT
  at.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS term_name,
  c.SUBJECT_ID,
  c.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  c.PREREQUISITES,
  c.FALL_INSTRUCTORS AS instructor,
  COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.TERM_CODE) AS total_subjects_offered_in_term,
  COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.TERM_CODE, c.FALL_INSTRUCTORS) AS subjects_taught_by_instructor_in_term
FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at
  ON at.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE
WHERE c.TERM_CODE = '2023FA'
  AND c.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y'
ORDER BY
  c.SUBJECT_ID,
  c.FALL_INSTRUCTORS;

SELECT
  r.ROOM_FULL_NAME AS room_full_name,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  f.FLOOR AS floor_number,
  o.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name,
  o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
  CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS room_area,
  CAST(f.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS floor_assignable_area,
  CAST(b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS building_assignable_area,
  ROUND(
    100 * CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,6)) / NULLIF(CAST(f.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS DECIMAL(18,6)), 0),
    4
  ) AS pct_of_usable_floor_area,
  ROUND(
    100 * CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,6)) / NULLIF(CAST(b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS DECIMAL(18,6)), 0),
    4
  ) AS pct_of_usable_building_area
FROM FAC_ROOMS r
JOIN FAC_BUILDING b
  ON r.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN FAC_FLOOR f
  ON r.FLOOR_KEY = f.FLOOR_KEY
JOIN FAC_ORGANIZATION o
  ON r.ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.ORGANIZATION_KEY
ORDER BY
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  f.FLOOR,
  r.ROOM_FULL_NAME;

SELECT
  r.FAC_ROOM_KEY,
  r.ROOM_FULL_NAME AS room_full_name,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  r.FLOOR AS floor_number,
  o.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name,
  o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
  CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS room_area,
  CAST(floor_tot.total_floor_area AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS total_floor_area,
  CAST(bldg_tot.total_building_area AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS total_building_area,
  CASE
    WHEN floor_tot.total_floor_area IS NULL OR floor_tot.total_floor_area = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,8)) / floor_tot.total_floor_area
  END AS share_of_total_floor_area,
  CASE
    WHEN bldg_tot.total_building_area IS NULL OR bldg_tot.total_building_area = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,8)) / bldg_tot.total_building_area
  END AS share_of_total_building_area
FROM FAC_ROOMS r
LEFT JOIN FAC_BUILDING b
  ON b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = r.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN FAC_ORGANIZATION o
  ON o.ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.ORGANIZATION_KEY
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    FLOOR_KEY,
    SUM(CAST(AREA AS DECIMAL(18,4))) AS total_floor_area
  FROM FAC_ROOMS
  GROUP BY FLOOR_KEY
) AS floor_tot
  ON floor_tot.FLOOR_KEY = r.FLOOR_KEY
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    SUM(CAST(AREA AS DECIMAL(18,4))) AS total_building_area
  FROM FAC_ROOMS
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
) AS bldg_tot
  ON bldg_tot.BUILDING_KEY = r.BUILDING_KEY
ORDER BY
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  r.FLOOR,
  r.ROOM_FULL_NAME;

SELECT
  ed.FULL_NAME AS instructor_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT so.COURSE_NUMBER) AS different_courses_taught
FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so
JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata
  ON so.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE
JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ed
  ON so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = ed.MIT_ID
WHERE ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2022'
GROUP BY ed.FULL_NAME
ORDER BY different_courses_taught DESC, instructor_name;

SELECT
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  o.ORGANIZATION AS organization,
  o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
  MIN(CAST(f.LEVEL_ID AS SIGNED)) AS lowest_floor,
  MAX(CAST(f.LEVEL_ID AS SIGNED)) AS highest_floor,
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.FAC_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count
FROM FAC_BUILDING b
JOIN FAC_ROOMS r
  ON b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = r.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN FAC_FLOOR f
  ON f.FLOOR_KEY = r.FLOOR_KEY
JOIN FAC_ORGANIZATION o
  ON o.ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.ORGANIZATION_KEY
GROUP BY
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  o.ORGANIZATION,
  o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME
ORDER BY
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  o.ORGANIZATION;

SELECT
  msd.FULL_NAME AS student_full_name,
  msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS student_email,
  sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
  sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name,
  sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone_number,
  dept_counts.students_in_department,
  school_counts.students_in_school
FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
  ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad
  ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
JOIN (
  SELECT
    DEPARTMENT AS department_code,
    COUNT(*) AS students_in_department
  FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY
  GROUP BY DEPARTMENT
) AS dept_counts
  ON dept_counts.department_code = msd.DEPARTMENT
JOIN (
  SELECT
    sd2.SCHOOL_CODE,
    COUNT(*) AS students_in_school
  FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd2
  JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd2
    ON msd2.DEPARTMENT = sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  GROUP BY sd2.SCHOOL_CODE
) AS school_counts
  ON school_counts.SCHOOL_CODE = sd.SCHOOL_CODE
WHERE msd.FIRST_NAME = 'Kevin'
ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.FULL_NAME, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS;

SELECT
  c.TERM_CODE,
  c.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  e.FULL_NAME AS responsible_instructor_name,
  e.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS responsible_instructor_email,
  ic.fall_subject_count_total
FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t
  ON t.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE
JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY e
  ON e.MIT_ID = c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
JOIN (
  SELECT
    c2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c2.SUBJECT_ID) AS fall_subject_count_total
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c2
  JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t2
    ON t2.TERM_CODE = c2.TERM_CODE
  WHERE t2.TERM_CODE LIKE '%FA'
    AND c2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY c2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
) ic
  ON ic.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
WHERE t.TERM_CODE LIKE '%FA'
  AND c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  e.FULL_NAME,
  c.TERM_CODE,
  c.SUBJECT_TITLE;

SELECT
  b.BUILDING_KEY,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS hr_department_name,
  YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(fb.DATE_BUILT, '%m/%d/%Y')) AS built_year,
  b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS gross_square_footage,
  b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS assignable_square_footage,
  AVG(CAST(fr.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS avg_assignable_square_footage
FROM BUILDINGS b
JOIN FAC_BUILDING fb
  ON b.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN FAC_ROOMS fr
  ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = fr.BUILDING_KEY
JOIN FAC_ORGANIZATION o
  ON fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.ORGANIZATION_KEY
GROUP BY
  b.BUILDING_KEY,
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(fb.DATE_BUILT, '%m/%d/%Y')),
  b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE
ORDER BY
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT
  c.TERM_CODE,
  c.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  c.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  c.SUBJECT_ID,
  c.PRINT_SUBJECT_ID,
  c.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  c.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION,
  c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS instructor_name,
  e.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS instructor_email,
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  fr.ROOM_FULL_NAME AS room_name,
  fr.FLOOR AS room_floor,
  ff.LEVEL_ID AS floor_level_id,
  fba.STREET_NUMBER,
  fba.STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX,
  fba.PRE_DIRECTIONAL,
  fba.STREET_NAME,
  fba.STREET_SUFFIX,
  fba.POST_DIRECTIONAL,
  fba.CITY,
  fba.STATE,
  fba.POSTAL_CODE,
  dept_counts.total_courses_in_department
FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t
  ON t.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY e
  ON e.MIT_ID = c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
LEFT JOIN FAC_ROOMS fr
  ON fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY = c.MEET_PLACE
LEFT JOIN FAC_FLOOR ff
  ON ff.FLOOR_KEY = fr.FLOOR_KEY
LEFT JOIN BUILDINGS b
  ON b.BUILDING_KEY = fr.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba
  ON fba.BUILDING_KEY = fr.BUILDING_KEY
 AND fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
JOIN (
  SELECT
    TERM_CODE,
    DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS total_courses_in_department
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED
  GROUP BY TERM_CODE, DEPARTMENT_CODE
) AS dept_counts
  ON dept_counts.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE
 AND dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WHERE c.TERM_CODE LIKE '%SU%';

SELECT
  t.TERM_CODE,
  t.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  d.SCHOOL_CODE,
  d.SCHOOL_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS unique_subjects_offered
FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
JOIN CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE h
  ON h.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d
  ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE
JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t
  ON t.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE
WHERE h.CIS_ATTRIBUTE_GROUP = 'H'
GROUP BY
  t.TERM_CODE,
  t.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  d.SCHOOL_CODE,
  d.SCHOOL_NAME
ORDER BY
  t.TERM_CODE,
  d.SCHOOL_NAME,
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT
    fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
    fb.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
    fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT AS building_height,
    b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS AS street_address,
    fba.CITY AS city,
    fba.STATE AS state,
    fba.POSTAL_CODE AS postal_code,
    CAST(fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS gross_square_footage,
    CAST(fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS assignable_square_footage,
    flr.min_level_id AS lowest_floor_level,
    flr.max_level_id AS highest_floor_level,
    rm.total_room_area AS total_room_area
FROM FAC_BUILDING fb
LEFT JOIN BUILDINGS b
    ON b.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba
    ON fba.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
   AND fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        BUILDING_KEY,
        MIN(CAST(LEVEL_ID AS SIGNED)) AS min_level_id,
        MAX(CAST(LEVEL_ID AS SIGNED)) AS max_level_id
    FROM FAC_FLOOR
    WHERE LEVEL_ID REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+$'
    GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
) flr
    ON flr.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        fr.BUILDING_KEY,
        SUM(CAST(fr.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS total_room_area
    FROM FAC_ROOMS fr
    GROUP BY fr.BUILDING_KEY
) rm
    ON rm.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
ORDER BY fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY;

SELECT
  c.CATEGORY_CODE AS cip_category_code,
  c.CATEGORY_TITLE AS cip_category_title,
  d.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS department_code,
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
  d.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name,
  SUM(CASE WHEN scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS undergraduate_courses,
  SUM(CASE WHEN scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS graduate_courses,
  SUM(CASE WHEN scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS degree_granting_courses
FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd
JOIN CIP c
  ON scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE = c.PROGRAM_CODE
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d
  ON scd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
GROUP BY
  c.CATEGORY_CODE,
  c.CATEGORY_TITLE,
  d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  d.SCHOOL_NAME
ORDER BY
  c.CATEGORY_CODE,
  d.SCHOOL_NAME,
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT
  lci.COURSE_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lrc.CATALOG_SYSTEM_NUMBER) AS reserve_item_count,
  MIN(CASE WHEN lrc.CATALOG_YEAR REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN CAST(lrc.CATALOG_YEAR AS UNSIGNED) END) AS oldest_publication_year,
  MAX(CASE WHEN lrc.CATALOG_YEAR REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN CAST(lrc.CATALOG_YEAR AS UNSIGNED) END) AS newest_publication_year,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS) AS distinct_status_type_count
FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
JOIN LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci
  ON lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
  ON lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS lms
  ON lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
GROUP BY lci.COURSE_NAME
ORDER BY lci.COURSE_NAME;

SELECT
  lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lrc.CATALOG_SYSTEM_NUMBER) AS reserve_item_count,
  MIN(CASE WHEN lrc.CATALOG_YEAR REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN CAST(lrc.CATALOG_YEAR AS UNSIGNED) END) AS oldest_publication_year,
  MAX(CASE WHEN lrc.CATALOG_YEAR REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN CAST(lrc.CATALOG_YEAR AS UNSIGNED) END) AS newest_publication_year,
  SUM(DISTINCT lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_students_enrolled
FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci
JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
  ON lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
  ON lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso
  ON lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
GROUP BY
  lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME
ORDER BY
  lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME;

SELECT
  at.TERM_CODE,
  at.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  ms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE,
  ms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS,
  COUNT(DISTINCT so.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS num_courses,

  COUNT(DISTINCT so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS num_departments,
  COUNT(DISTINCT so.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) AS num_schools,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME) AS num_instructors
FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL rmd
JOIN LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS ms
  ON ms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = rmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED so
  ON so.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = rmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at
  ON at.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE
JOIN LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR ci
  ON ci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = rmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG rc
  ON rc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = rmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
GROUP BY
  at.TERM_CODE,
  at.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  ms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE,
  ms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS
ORDER BY
  at.TERM_CODE,
  ms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE,
  ms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS;

WITH floor_counts AS (
  SELECT
    sd.BUILDING_KEY,
    sd.FLOOR_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organizations_on_floor,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_units_on_floor
  FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd
  JOIN SPACE_UNIT su
    ON su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
  JOIN BUILDINGS b
    ON b.BUILDING_KEY = sd.BUILDING_KEY
  WHERE b.BUILDING_NUMBER = '36'
  GROUP BY sd.BUILDING_KEY, sd.FLOOR_KEY
)
SELECT
  sf.FLOOR AS floor,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  COALESCE(fba.STREET_NUMBER, '') AS street_number,
  TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ',
    NULLIF(fba.PRE_DIRECTIONAL, ''),
    NULLIF(fba.STREET_NAME, ''),
    NULLIF(fba.STREET_SUFFIX, ''),
    NULLIF(fba.POST_DIRECTIONAL, '')
  )) AS street_name,
  fba.CITY AS city,
  fba.STATE AS state,
  fba.POSTAL_CODE AS postal_code,
  su.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit,
  fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name,
  susage.SPACE_USAGE AS space_usage,
  fc.organizations_on_floor,
  fc.space_units_on_floor
FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd
JOIN BUILDINGS b
  ON b.BUILDING_KEY = sd.BUILDING_KEY
JOIN SPACE_FLOOR sf
  ON sf.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY
JOIN SPACE_UNIT su
  ON su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo
  ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
JOIN SPACE_USAGE susage
  ON susage.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY
LEFT JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba
  ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
 AND fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
JOIN floor_counts fc
  ON fc.BUILDING_KEY = sd.BUILDING_KEY
 AND fc.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY
WHERE b.BUILDING_NUMBER = '36'
ORDER BY sf.FLOOR, su.SPACE_UNIT, susage.SPACE_USAGE, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME;

SELECT
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  mlo.OWNER,
  ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST,
  ml.IS_MOIRA_GROUP,
  ml.IS_NFS_GROUP,
  COUNT(*) AS member_count
FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
  ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
LEFT JOIN MOIRA_LIST_OWNER mlo
  ON mlo.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
WHERE ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME LIKE 'A%'
GROUP BY
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  mlo.OWNER,
  ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST,
  ml.IS_MOIRA_GROUP,
  ml.IS_NFS_GROUP
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000
ORDER BY member_count DESC, ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, mlo.OWNER;

WITH member_counts AS (
  SELECT
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    mlo.OWNER,
    ml.IS_PUBLIC,
    ml.IS_HIDDEN,
    COUNT(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS member_count
  FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
  LEFT JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  LEFT JOIN MOIRA_LIST_OWNER mlo
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = mlo.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
  GROUP BY
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    mlo.OWNER,
    ml.IS_PUBLIC,
    ml.IS_HIDDEN
),
extremes AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(member_count) AS min_member_count,
    MAX(member_count) AS max_member_count
  FROM member_counts
)
SELECT
  mc.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  mc.OWNER,
  mc.IS_PUBLIC,
  mc.IS_HIDDEN,
  mc.member_count
FROM member_counts mc
JOIN extremes e
  ON mc.member_count IN (e.min_member_count, e.max_member_count)
ORDER BY
  mc.member_count,
  mc.MOIRA_LIST_NAME;

SELECT
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS mailing_list_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS member_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ed.MIT_ID) AS different_faculty_count
FROM MOIRA_LIST AS ml
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL AS mld
  ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c
  ON c.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE
JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at
  ON at.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY AS ed
  ON ed.MIT_ID = c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
WHERE ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y'
  AND ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME LIKE 'C%'
  AND at.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR > '2001'
  AND at.TERM_CODE LIKE '%SU'
GROUP BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
ORDER BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME;

WITH list_students AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
         mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID AS mit_id
  FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
  JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  JOIN SE_PERSON sp
    ON sp.MIT_ID = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID
  WHERE ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'candle-duo-users'
    AND sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Student'
    AND sp.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y'
    AND mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
),
student_dept AS (
  SELECT
    ls.mit_id,
    msd.DEPARTMENT AS department_code
  FROM list_students ls
  JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd
    ON msd.MIT_ID = ls.mit_id
)
SELECT
  'TOTAL_STUDENTS' AS result_type,
  NULL AS department_code,
  NULL AS department_name,
  NULL AS school_code,
  NULL AS school_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT mit_id) AS student_count
FROM student_dept

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'BY_DEPARTMENT' AS result_type,
  sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS department_code,
  sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
  sd.SCHOOL_CODE AS school_code,
  sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sde.mit_id) AS student_count
FROM student_dept sde
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
  ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sde.department_code
GROUP BY
  sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_CODE, sd.SCHOOL_NAME

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'BY_SCHOOL' AS result_type,
  NULL AS department_code,
  NULL AS department_name,
  sd.SCHOOL_CODE AS school_code,
  sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sde.mit_id) AS student_count
FROM student_dept sde
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
  ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sde.department_code
GROUP BY
  sd.SCHOOL_CODE, sd.SCHOOL_NAME
ORDER BY
  FIELD(result_type, 'TOTAL_STUDENTS', 'BY_SCHOOL', 'BY_DEPARTMENT'),
  school_name,
  department_name;

WITH list_member_counts AS (
  SELECT
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    COUNT(*) AS total_members
  FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
  GROUP BY mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  HAVING COUNT(*) = 10
),
fall2023_faculty AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID AS mit_id
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
  WHERE c.TERM_CODE = '2023FA'
    AND c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
),
faculty_total_courses AS (
  SELECT
    c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID AS mit_id,
    COUNT(*) AS total_courses_taught
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
  WHERE c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
)
SELECT
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  lmc.total_members,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f23.mit_id IS NOT NULL THEN ed.MIT_ID END) AS fall2023_faculty_members,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f23.mit_id IS NOT NULL THEN ftc.total_courses_taught ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_courses_taught_by_those_faculty
FROM list_member_counts lmc
JOIN MOIRA_LIST ml
  ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = lmc.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
  ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = lmc.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ed
  ON ed.KRB_NAME = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER
LEFT JOIN fall2023_faculty f23
  ON f23.mit_id = ed.MIT_ID
LEFT JOIN faculty_total_courses ftc
  ON ftc.mit_id = ed.MIT_ID
GROUP BY
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  lmc.total_members
ORDER BY
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME;

SELECT
    lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME AS instructor_name,
    MIN(CAST(NULLIF(lrc.CATALOG_YEAR, '0') AS UNSIGNED)) AS earliest_publication_year,
    MAX(CAST(NULLIF(lrc.CATALOG_YEAR, '0') AS UNSIGNED)) AS latest_publication_year,
    SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_students_enrolled
FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
JOIN SE_PERSON sp
    ON sp.KRB_NAME = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER
JOIN LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci
    ON lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME = sp.FULL_NAME
JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
    ON lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
    ON lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso
    ON lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
WHERE ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'keeper-zephyr'

GROUP BY lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME
ORDER BY lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME;

SELECT

  ml.MOIRA_LIST_DESCRIPTION AS description,
  mlo.OWNER AS owner,
  COUNT(DISTINCT mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS total_members,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sp.PAYROLL_RANK LIKE '%Tenured%' THEN mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER END) AS tenured_faculty_members

LEFT JOIN MOIRA_LIST_OWNER mlo

    SELECT 1

    WHERE mld2.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY

  )

  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_DESCRIPTION,
  mlo.OWNER
ORDER BY
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  mlo.OWNER;

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Management' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS management_students,
  ROUND(
    100 * SUM(CASE WHEN sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Management' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
    2
  ) AS percent_of_list
FROM MOIRA_LIST ml

JOIN SE_PERSON sp
  ON sp.KRB_NAME = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER
JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd
  ON msd.FULL_NAME = sp.FULL_NAME

  ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT

WITH floor_counts AS (
  SELECT
    ff.BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ff.LEVEL_ID) AS floor_cnt
  FROM FAC_FLOOR ff
  GROUP BY ff.BUILDING_KEY
),
max_floor_buildings AS (
  SELECT fc.building_key
  FROM floor_counts fc
  WHERE fc.floor_cnt = (SELECT MAX(floor_cnt) FROM floor_counts)
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  fb.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS mailing_list_name
FROM max_floor_buildings mfb
JOIN FAC_BUILDING fb
  ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = mfb.building_key

  ON fr.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ed
  ON ed.OFFICE_LOCATION = fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
  ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER = ed.KRB_NAME
JOIN MOIRA_LIST ml
  ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
WHERE ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME LIKE 'a%'
  AND ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y'
  AND ed.KRB_NAME LIKE 'C%'

SELECT
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS mailing_list_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS courses_taught_by_y_faculty,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ed.MIT_ID) AS y_faculty_members_on_list

  ON ed.MIT_ID = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID

WHERE ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y'
  AND ed.LAST_NAME LIKE 'Y%'
GROUP BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
ORDER BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME;

SELECT
  msd.FULL_NAME AS student_name,
  sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone_number,
  mlc.list_size AS mailing_list_size
FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
  ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
JOIN SE_PERSON sp
  ON sp.KRB_NAME = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER
JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd
  ON msd.FULL_NAME = sp.FULL_NAME
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
  ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT
JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad
  ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
JOIN (
  SELECT mld2.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, COUNT(*) AS list_size
  FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld2
  GROUP BY mld2.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
) mlc
  ON mlc.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
WHERE ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'beacon-date-date'
  AND msd.LAST_NAME LIKE 'H%';

WITH ee_members_per_list AS (
  SELECT
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sp.MIT_ID) AS member_count
  FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
  JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  JOIN SE_PERSON sp
    ON sp.KRB_NAME = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER
  WHERE ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y'
    AND ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME LIKE 'B%'
    AND sp.ORGANIZATION = 'Electrical Engineering and Computer Science'
  GROUP BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ee_members_per_list) AS num_lists,
  (SELECT MOIRA_LIST_NAME
   FROM ee_members_per_list
   ORDER BY member_count DESC, MOIRA_LIST_NAME
   LIMIT 1) AS list_with_most_members,
  (SELECT member_count
   FROM ee_members_per_list
   ORDER BY member_count DESC, MOIRA_LIST_NAME
   LIMIT 1) AS most_members_count;

WITH list_students AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    sp.KRB_NAME,
    msd.DEPARTMENT
  FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
  JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  JOIN SE_PERSON sp
    ON sp.KRB_NAME = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER
  JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd
    ON msd.FULL_NAME = sp.FULL_NAME
  WHERE ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'kangaroo-inspire-yearn'
),
dept_counts AS (
  SELECT
    sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
    COUNT(*) AS student_count
  FROM list_students ls
  LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad
    ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = ls.DEPARTMENT
  GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME
),
total AS (
  SELECT SUM(student_count) AS total_students
  FROM dept_counts
)
SELECT
  dc.department_name,
  dc.student_count,
  ROUND(100.0 * dc.student_count / NULLIF(t.total_students, 0), 2) AS percent_of_list
FROM dept_counts dc
CROSS JOIN total t
ORDER BY dc.student_count DESC, dc.department_name;

SELECT
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS subscriber_count
FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
  ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ed
  ON ed.KRB_NAME = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER
WHERE ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y'
  AND ed.OFFICE_LOCATION LIKE '24%'
GROUP BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
ORDER BY subscriber_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  ml.IS_ACTIVE,
  SUM(CASE WHEN sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Support Staff' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS support_staff_subscribers,
  SUM(CASE WHEN sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Faculty' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS faculty_subscribers

WHERE ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y'

ORDER BY
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME;

SELECT
  d.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
  d.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone_number,
  COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count
FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
  ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
JOIN SE_PERSON sp
  ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER = sp.KRB_NAME

  ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME

WHERE ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'ocean-apple'

SELECT
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS group_name,
  mlo.OWNER AS owner,
  mlo.OWNER_TYPE AS owner_type,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ml.IS_PUBLIC = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS public_member_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ml.IS_PUBLIC <> 'Y' OR ml.IS_PUBLIC IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hidden_member_count,
  COUNT(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS total_member_count
FROM MOIRA_LIST ml

  ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY

  ON mlo.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
WHERE ml.IS_MOIRA_GROUP = 'Y'

  mlo.OWNER,
  mlo.OWNER_TYPE
ORDER BY
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  mlo.OWNER_TYPE,
  mlo.OWNER;

WITH bio_courses AS (
  SELECT
    sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY,
    sos.COURSE_NUMBER,
    sos.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    sos.CLUSTER_TYPE,
    sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
  FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos
  WHERE sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME LIKE '%Biology%'
),
cluster_avg AS (
  SELECT
    bc.CLUSTER_TYPE,
    AVG(bc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment_for_cluster
  FROM bio_courses bc
  GROUP BY bc.CLUSTER_TYPE
),
tip_agg AS (
  SELECT
    td.SUBJECT_ID,
    td.TERM_CODE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_distinct_required_materials,
    AVG(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_new_shelf_price,
    AVG(tm.USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_used_shelf_price,
    SUM(COALESCE(td.RECORD_COUNT, 0)) AS total_tip_material_records
  FROM TIP_DETAIL td
  JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
    ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  GROUP BY td.SUBJECT_ID, td.TERM_CODE
),
lib_agg AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT lrc.CATALOG_TITLE) AS unique_library_reserve_titles,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lrc.CATALOG_ISBN) AS unique_library_reserve_isbns
  FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
)
SELECT
  bc.SUBJECT_TITLE AS course_title,
  bc.CLUSTER_TYPE AS cluster_type,
  scd.COURSE_LEVEL AS course_level,
  SUM(bc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment,
  ca.avg_enrollment_for_cluster,
  COALESCE(SUM(ta.num_distinct_required_materials), 0) AS num_distinct_required_materials,
  AVG(ta.avg_new_shelf_price) AS avg_new_shelf_price,
  AVG(ta.avg_used_shelf_price) AS avg_used_shelf_price,
  COALESCE(SUM(ta.total_tip_material_records), 0) AS total_tip_material_records,
  la.unique_library_reserve_titles,
  la.unique_library_reserve_isbns
FROM bio_courses bc
LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd
  ON scd.COURSE = bc.COURSE_NUMBER
LEFT JOIN cluster_avg ca
  ON ca.CLUSTER_TYPE = bc.CLUSTER_TYPE
LEFT JOIN tip_agg ta
  ON ta.SUBJECT_ID = bc.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY
CROSS JOIN lib_agg la
GROUP BY
  bc.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  bc.CLUSTER_TYPE,
  scd.COURSE_LEVEL,
  ca.avg_enrollment_for_cluster,
  la.unique_library_reserve_titles,
  la.unique_library_reserve_isbns
ORDER BY
  bc.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  bc.CLUSTER_TYPE,
  scd.COURSE_LEVEL;

SELECT
  ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  sd.SCHOOL_NAME,
  ccs.SUBJECT_ID,
  ccs.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  scd.COURSE_LEVEL,
  ccs.TOTAL_UNITS,
  ccs.TERM_CODE,
  at.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  CASE
    WHEN ccs.FALL_INSTRUCTORS IS NULL OR TRIM(ccs.FALL_INSTRUCTORS) = '' THEN 0
    ELSE 1 + (LENGTH(ccs.FALL_INSTRUCTORS) - LENGTH(REPLACE(ccs.FALL_INSTRUCTORS, ',', '')))
  END AS FALL_INSTRUCTOR_COUNT,
  CASE
    WHEN ccs.SPRING_INSTRUCTORS IS NULL OR TRIM(ccs.SPRING_INSTRUCTORS) = '' THEN 0
    ELSE 1 + (LENGTH(ccs.SPRING_INSTRUCTORS) - LENGTH(REPLACE(ccs.SPRING_INSTRUCTORS, ',', '')))
  END AS SPRING_INSTRUCTOR_COUNT
FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs
JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at
  ON at.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
  ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd
  ON scd.COURSE = ccs.SUBJECT_CODE
 AND ccs.TERM_CODE BETWEEN scd.FROM_TERM AND scd.THRU_TERM
WHERE ccs.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y'
  AND (ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' OR ccs.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = 'Y')
ORDER BY
  ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  sd.SCHOOL_NAME,
  ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  ccs.SUBJECT_ID,
  ccs.TERM_CODE;

WITH ps_subjects AS (
  SELECT
    c.SUBJECT_ID,
    c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE,
    c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC,
    sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC,
    CAST(c.TOTAL_UNITS AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS total_units,
    d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING
  FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c
  JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc
    ON c.SUBJECT_CODE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE
  JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d
    ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'
),
enroll_by_subject AS (
  SELECT
    s.SUBJECT_ID,
    SUM(COALESCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) AS total_enrollment
  FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s
  GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_ID
)
SELECT
  p.HASS_ATTRIBUTE,
  p.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC,
  p.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_courses,
  AVG(p.total_units) AS avg_units,
  SUM(COALESCE(e.total_enrollment, 0)) AS total_enrollment,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' THEN p.SUBJECT_ID END) AS num_courses_from_degree_granting_departments
FROM ps_subjects p
LEFT JOIN enroll_by_subject e
  ON e.SUBJECT_ID = p.SUBJECT_ID
GROUP BY
  p.HASS_ATTRIBUTE,
  p.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC,
  p.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC
ORDER BY
  p.HASS_ATTRIBUTE,
  p.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC;

SELECT
  sos.CLUSTER_TYPE AS cluster_type,
  sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS department_code,
  sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name,
  sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name,
  sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING AS is_degree_granting,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS subjects_offered_count,
  SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_student_enrollment,
  AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_student_enrollment
FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos
LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
  ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd
  ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER
WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1
GROUP BY
  sos.CLUSTER_TYPE,
  sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
  sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
  sd.SCHOOL_NAME,
  sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING
ORDER BY
  sos.CLUSTER_TYPE,
  sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
  sd.SCHOOL_NAME,
  sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING;

SELECT
  b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
    WHEN cd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' THEN so.SUBJECT_ID
    ELSE NULL
  END) AS distinct_courses_grad,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
    WHEN cd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' THEN so.SUBJECT_ID
    ELSE NULL
  END) AS distinct_courses_undergrad,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
    WHEN cd.COURSE_LEVEL NOT IN ('G','U') OR cd.COURSE_LEVEL IS NULL THEN so.SUBJECT_ID
    ELSE NULL
  END) AS distinct_courses_other,
  COUNT(DISTINCT so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME) AS unique_instructors_overall
FROM FAC_BUILDING b
JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so
  ON so.MEET_PLACE = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd
  ON cd.COURSE = so.COURSE_NUMBER
WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT'
GROUP BY
  b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
  b.BUILDING_NAME
ORDER BY
  b.BUILDING_NUMBER;

SELECT
  c.TERM_CODE,
  r.FAC_ROOM_KEY AS MEET_PLACE,
  b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  ba.CITY,
  ba.STATE,
  r.AREA,
  r.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  mu.MAJOR_USE AS ROOM_USAGE,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS DISTINCT_COURSES_SCHEDULED,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.MEET_TIME) AS DISTINCT_MEETING_TIMES,
  SUM(COALESCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 0)) AS TOTAL_UNITS_TAUGHT
FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
JOIN FAC_ROOMS r
  ON r.FAC_ROOM_KEY = c.MEET_PLACE
JOIN FAC_BUILDING b
  ON b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = r.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN FAC_MAJOR_USE mu
  ON mu.MAJOR_USE_KEY = r.MAJOR_USE_KEY
LEFT JOIN FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS ba
  ON ba.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
 AND ba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd
  ON scd.COURSE = c.SUBJECT_ID
GROUP BY
  c.TERM_CODE,
  r.FAC_ROOM_KEY,
  b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  ba.CITY,
  ba.STATE,
  r.AREA,
  r.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  mu.MAJOR_USE
ORDER BY
  c.TERM_CODE,
  b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
  r.FAC_ROOM_KEY;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status,
    ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
    lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY AS catalog_key,
    lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY AS subject_offered_key,
    lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS num_enrolled_students
  FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
  JOIN LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS lms
    ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
  JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
    ON lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso
    ON lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc
    ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER
  WHERE CAST(lrc.CATALOG_YEAR AS UNSIGNED) >= 2000
),
items_by_group AS (
  SELECT
    material_status,
    department_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT catalog_key) AS items_count
  FROM base
  GROUP BY material_status, department_name
),
students_by_group AS (
  SELECT
    material_status,
    department_name,
    SUM(num_enrolled_students) AS students_enrolled
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      material_status,
      department_name,
      subject_offered_key,
      num_enrolled_students
    FROM base
  ) x
  GROUP BY material_status, department_name
),
detail AS (
  SELECT
    i.material_status,
    i.department_name,
    i.items_count,
    COALESCE(s.students_enrolled, 0) AS students_enrolled
  FROM items_by_group i
  LEFT JOIN students_by_group s
    ON s.material_status = i.material_status
   AND s.department_name = i.department_name
)
SELECT
  material_status,
  department_name,
  SUM(items_count) AS items_count,
  SUM(students_enrolled) AS students_enrolled
FROM (
  SELECT material_status, department_name, items_count, students_enrolled FROM detail
  UNION ALL
  SELECT material_status, 'TOTAL' AS department_name, items_count, students_enrolled FROM detail
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'OVERALL TOTAL' AS material_status, 'TOTAL' AS department_name, items_count, students_enrolled FROM detail
) u
GROUP BY material_status, department_name
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN material_status = 'OVERALL TOTAL' THEN 2
    WHEN department_name = 'TOTAL' THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END,
  material_status,
  department_name;

WITH course_level AS (
  SELECT
    lci.DEPARTMENT,
    lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,
    lci.COURSE_NAME,
    MAX(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_items_used
  FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci
  JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm
    ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrm.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
  JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso
    ON lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lrm.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1
  GROUP BY
    lci.DEPARTMENT,
    lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,
    lci.COURSE_NAME
)
SELECT
  DEPARTMENT,
  COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_NAME) AS courses_with_enrollment,
  SUM(catalog_items_used) AS catalog_items_used,
  AVG(enrollment) AS avg_enrollment_per_course
FROM course_level
GROUP BY DEPARTMENT

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'ALL DEPARTMENTS' AS DEPARTMENT,
  COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_NAME) AS courses_with_enrollment,
  SUM(catalog_items_used) AS catalog_items_used,
  AVG(enrollment) AS avg_enrollment_per_course
FROM course_level
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN DEPARTMENT = 'ALL DEPARTMENTS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  DEPARTMENT;

SELECT
  COALESCE(d.SCHOOL_NAME, 'ALL SCHOOLS') AS school_name,
  COALESCE(so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, 'ALL DEPARTMENTS') AS department_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS distinct_materials,
  COUNT(DISTINCT so.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS distinct_courses,
  AVG(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_new_shelf_price,
  AVG(tm.USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_used_shelf_price,
  SUM(COALESCE(td.RECORD_COUNT, 0)) AS total_material_records,
  COUNT(DISTINCT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS) AS distinct_material_statuses
FROM TIP_DETAIL td
JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED so
  ON so.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
  ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms
  ON tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d
  ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
WHERE COALESCE(so.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL, 'N') <> 'Y'
GROUP BY d.SCHOOL_NAME, so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'ALL SCHOOLS' AS school_name,
  'ALL DEPARTMENTS' AS department_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS distinct_materials,
  COUNT(DISTINCT so.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS distinct_courses,
  AVG(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_new_shelf_price,
  AVG(tm.USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_used_shelf_price,
  SUM(COALESCE(td.RECORD_COUNT, 0)) AS total_material_records,
  COUNT(DISTINCT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS) AS distinct_material_statuses
FROM TIP_DETAIL td
JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED so
  ON so.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
  ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms
  ON tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
WHERE COALESCE(so.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL, 'N') <> 'Y';

SELECT
  COALESCE(tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, 'GRAND TOTAL') AS tip_material_status,
  COUNT(DISTINCT tm.TITLE) AS different_materials,
  SUM(CASE WHEN td.RECORD_COUNT > 0 THEN td.RECORD_COUNT ELSE 0 END) AS total_records_gt_zero,
  SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_student_enrollment
FROM TIP_DETAIL td
JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms
  ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
  ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
  ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
GROUP BY tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS WITH ROLLUP;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG AS building_name,
    b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE AS ownership_type,
    f.FLOOR AS floor_number,
    r.BUILDING_ROOM AS room_number,
    o.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name,
    r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY AS room_key,
    COALESCE(r.AREA, 0) AS area
  FROM FCLT_ROOMS r
  JOIN FCLT_FLOOR f
    ON f.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = r.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY
  JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b
    ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = f.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o
    ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(area) AS grand_total_area
  FROM base
),
detail AS (
  SELECT
    building_name,
    ownership_type,
    floor_number,
    room_number,
    organization_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT room_key) AS room_count,
    SUM(area) AS total_area
  FROM base
  GROUP BY
    building_name, ownership_type, floor_number, room_number, organization_name
),
building_subtotals AS (
  SELECT
    building_name,
    ownership_type,

    NULL AS room_number,
    NULL AS organization_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT room_key) AS room_count,
    SUM(area) AS total_area
  FROM base
  GROUP BY
    building_name, ownership_type
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    NULL AS building_name,
    NULL AS ownership_type,
    NULL AS floor_number,
    NULL AS room_number,
    NULL AS organization_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT room_key) AS room_count,
    SUM(area) AS total_area
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  x.building_name,
  x.ownership_type,
  x.floor_number,
  x.room_number,
  x.organization_name,
  x.room_count,
  x.total_area,
  CASE
    WHEN t.grand_total_area = 0 THEN 0
    ELSE x.total_area / t.grand_total_area
  END AS area_share_of_grand_total
FROM (
  SELECT
    1 AS sort_group,
    building_name, ownership_type, floor_number, room_number, organization_name,
    room_count, total_area
  FROM detail

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    2 AS sort_group,
    building_name, ownership_type, floor_number, room_number, organization_name,
    room_count, total_area
  FROM building_subtotals

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    3 AS sort_group,
    building_name, ownership_type, floor_number, room_number, organization_name,
    room_count, total_area
  FROM grand_total
) x
CROSS JOIN totals t
ORDER BY

  COALESCE(x.ownership_type, 'ZZZZZZ'),

  COALESCE(x.room_number, 'ZZZZZZ'),

SELECT

    at.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tm.FISCAL_PERIOD) AS fiscal_periods_covered,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tq.FY_QUARTER_CODE) AS quarters_covered,
    MIN(td.START_DATE) AS first_term_start_date,
    MAX(td.END_DATE) AS last_term_end_date,
    COUNT(DISTINCT atp.TERM_PARAMETER) AS department_term_parameters

LEFT JOIN TIME_QUARTER tq
    ON tq.FISCAL_YEAR = tm.FISCAL_YEAR
LEFT JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp

GROUP BY

ORDER BY

WITH
addr AS (

    FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    MAX(CITY)  AS CITY,
    MAX(STATE) AS STATE

  GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
),
floors AS (
  SELECT
    FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT FLOOR) AS floor_count
  FROM FCLT_FLOOR
  GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
),
rooms AS (
  SELECT
    FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count
  FROM FCLT_ROOMS
  GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    b.CAMPUS_SECTOR,
    b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
    a.CITY,
    a.STATE,
    b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    COALESCE(f.floor_count, 0) AS floor_count,

    COALESCE(r.room_count, 0) AS room_count,
    COALESCE(r.org_count, 0) AS org_count
  FROM FCLT_BUILDING b
  LEFT JOIN addr  a ON a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN floors f ON f.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN rooms  r ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
)
SELECT
  CAMPUS_SECTOR,
  BUILDING_NUMBER,
  BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
  CITY,
  STATE,
  OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
  floor_count AS num_floors,

  org_count AS num_organizations
FROM base

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'TOTAL' AS CAMPUS_SECTOR,
  NULL AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
  NULL AS BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
  NULL AS CITY,
  NULL AS STATE,
  NULL AS OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
  SUM(floor_count) AS num_floors,
  SUM(assignable_area) AS total_assignable_area,
  SUM(room_count) AS num_rooms,
  SUM(org_count) AS num_organizations
FROM base

WITH
tip_materials_by_dept AS (
  SELECT
    tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS dept_name,
    tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY,
    tm.TITLE,
    tm.ISBN
  FROM TIP_DETAIL td
  JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
    ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
    ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  GROUP BY
    tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY,
    tm.TITLE,
    tm.ISBN
),
reserve_by_isbn AS (
  SELECT
    lrc.CATALOG_ISBN AS isbn,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT lrmd.TERM_CODE ORDER BY lrmd.TERM_CODE SEPARATOR ', ') AS reserve_terms,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY) AS instructors_using_count
  FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
  JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
    ON lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  WHERE lrc.CATALOG_ISBN IS NOT NULL AND lrc.CATALOG_ISBN <> ''
  GROUP BY lrc.CATALOG_ISBN
),
dept_reserve_totals AS (
  SELECT
    lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS dept_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS dept_total_reserve_items
  FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
  JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso
    ON lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
),
overall_reserve_total AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS overall_total_reserve_items
  FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
)
SELECT
  t.dept_name AS department_name,
  t.TITLE AS tip_title,
  t.ISBN AS tip_isbn,
  CASE
    WHEN r.isbn IS NULL THEN 'N'
    ELSE 'Y'
  END AS is_on_library_reserve,
  r.reserve_terms AS reserve_term_codes,
  COALESCE(r.instructors_using_count, 0) AS instructors_using_it,
  COALESCE(drt.dept_total_reserve_items, 0) AS dept_total_reserve_items,
  ort.overall_total_reserve_items AS overall_total_reserve_items
FROM tip_materials_by_dept t
LEFT JOIN reserve_by_isbn r
  ON r.isbn = t.ISBN
LEFT JOIN dept_reserve_totals drt
  ON drt.dept_name = t.dept_name
CROSS JOIN overall_reserve_total ort
ORDER BY
  t.dept_name,
  t.TITLE,
  t.ISBN;

WITH
tip_counts AS (
  SELECT
    tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS dept_name,
    tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status,
    COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS tip_materials,
    0 AS library_materials
  FROM TIP_DETAIL td
  JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
    ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms
    ON tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
  GROUP BY
    tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS
),
library_counts AS (
  SELECT
    lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS dept_name,
    lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status,
    0 AS tip_materials,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lrd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS library_materials
  FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrd
  JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso
    ON lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lrd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  JOIN LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS lms
    ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
  GROUP BY
    lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS
),
combined AS (
  SELECT dept_name, material_status, tip_materials, library_materials FROM tip_counts
  UNION ALL
  SELECT dept_name, material_status, tip_materials, library_materials FROM library_counts
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(dept_name, 'Grand Total') AS department,
  COALESCE(material_status, 'Department Total') AS material_status,
  SUM(tip_materials) AS tip_materials,
  SUM(library_materials) AS library_materials,
  SUM(tip_materials) + SUM(library_materials) AS overall_total
FROM combined
GROUP BY dept_name, material_status WITH ROLLUP;

totals AS (

WITH latest_building AS (

  WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT'
),
room_org_by_building AS (

    r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,

    COUNT(DISTINCT o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS num_organizations

  LEFT JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o

)
SELECT
  lb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,

  SUM(COALESCE(rob.num_organizations, 0)) AS num_organizations

GROUP BY
  lb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,

WITH building_base AS (
  SELECT
    b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    b.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER,
    CASE
      WHEN b.BUILDING_USE = 'RESIDENT' THEN 'RESIDENTIAL'
      ELSE b.BUILDING_USE

    b.EXT_GROSS_AREA
  FROM FCLT_BUILDING b
),
building_orgs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
  FROM FCLT_ROOMS r
  WHERE r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY IS NOT NULL
),
use_rollup AS (
  SELECT
    bb.building_use_norm AS building_use,
    COUNT(DISTINCT bb.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER) AS building_count,
    SUM(bb.EXT_GROSS_AREA) AS total_gross_sqft,
    COUNT(DISTINCT bo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS distinct_organizations
  FROM building_base bb
  LEFT JOIN building_orgs bo
    ON bo.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  GROUP BY bb.building_use_norm
)
SELECT
  ur.building_use,
  ur.building_count,
  ur.total_gross_sqft,
  ur.distinct_organizations
FROM use_rollup ur

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'GRAND TOTAL' AS building_use,
  COUNT(DISTINCT bb.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER) AS building_count,
  SUM(bb.EXT_GROSS_AREA) AS total_gross_sqft,
  COUNT(DISTINCT bo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS distinct_organizations

  ON bo.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY

SELECT

  o.ASSIGNABLE AS assignable,

GROUP BY

SELECT

  t.major_use_description,
  t.num_rooms,
  t.total_area,
  t.avg_room_size
FROM (
  SELECT
    mu.ASSIGNABLE AS assignable_flag,

    COUNT(*) AS num_rooms,
    SUM(r.AREA) AS total_area,
    AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_room_size,
    0 AS sort_group
  FROM FCLT_ROOMS r
  JOIN FCLT_MAJOR_USE mu
    ON r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = mu.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY
  WHERE mu.MAJOR_USE <> 'ZUSE'
  GROUP BY
    mu.ASSIGNABLE,
    COALESCE(mu.DESCRIPTION, r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, mu.MAJOR_USE)

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    mu.ASSIGNABLE AS assignable_flag,
    'SUBTOTAL' AS major_use_description,
    COUNT(*) AS num_rooms,
    SUM(r.AREA) AS total_area,
    AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_room_size,
    1 AS sort_group
  FROM FCLT_ROOMS r
  JOIN FCLT_MAJOR_USE mu
    ON r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = mu.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY
  WHERE mu.MAJOR_USE <> 'ZUSE'
  GROUP BY mu.ASSIGNABLE

  t.sort_group,
  t.major_use_description;

WITH room_data AS (

    r.FLOOR_KEY,

  JOIN FAC_ROOMS r

  LEFT JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o
    ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.ORGANIZATION_KEY
  WHERE b.BUILDING_NAME = 'Ray and Maria Stata Center'
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    FLOOR_KEY,
    FLOOR,
    department_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT FAC_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count,
    SUM(area) AS total_room_area,
    AVG(area) AS avg_room_size
  FROM room_data
  GROUP BY FLOOR_KEY, FLOOR, department_name

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    FLOOR_KEY,
    FLOOR,
    'FLOOR TOTAL' AS department_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT FAC_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count,
    SUM(area) AS total_room_area,
    AVG(area) AS avg_room_size
  FROM room_data
  GROUP BY FLOOR_KEY, FLOOR

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    NULL AS FLOOR_KEY,
    NULL AS FLOOR,
    'GRAND TOTAL' AS department_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT FAC_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count,
    SUM(area) AS total_room_area,
    AVG(area) AS avg_room_size
  FROM room_data
)
SELECT
  FLOOR_KEY,
  FLOOR,
  department_name,
  room_count,
  total_room_area,
  avg_room_size
FROM agg
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN FLOOR IS NULL THEN 2
    WHEN department_name = 'FLOOR TOTAL' THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END,
  CAST(FLOOR AS UNSIGNED),
  department_name;

WITH addr AS (
  SELECT
    a.BUILDING_KEY,
    MAX(CASE WHEN a.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET' THEN a.CITY END) AS CITY,
    MAX(CASE WHEN a.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET' THEN a.POSTAL_CODE END) AS POSTAL_CODE
  FROM FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS a
  GROUP BY a.BUILDING_KEY
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    r.BUILDING_KEY,
    r.FLOOR,
    b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
    b.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME,
    ad.CITY,
    ad.POSTAL_CODE,
    r.FAC_ROOM_KEY,
    CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS AREA_NUM
  FROM FAC_ROOMS r
  JOIN FAC_ORGANIZATION o
    ON o.ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.ORGANIZATION_KEY
  JOIN FAC_BUILDING b
    ON b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = r.BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN addr ad
    ON ad.BUILDING_KEY = r.BUILDING_KEY
  WHERE o.ORGANIZATION_NAME = 'DP OF FACILITIES'
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN GROUPING(BUILDING_KEY) = 1 THEN 'ALL'
    ELSE BUILDING_KEY
  END AS BUILDING_KEY,
  CASE
    WHEN GROUPING(BUILDING_KEY) = 1 THEN 'OVERALL TOTAL'
    WHEN GROUPING(FLOOR) = 1 THEN 'BUILDING TOTAL'
    ELSE FLOOR
  END AS FLOOR,
  MAX(BUILDING_NAME_LONG) AS BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
  MAX(ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME) AS ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME,
  MAX(CITY) AS CITY,
  MAX(POSTAL_CODE) AS POSTAL_CODE,
  COUNT(DISTINCT FAC_ROOM_KEY) AS ROOM_COUNT,
  ROUND(SUM(AREA_NUM), 2) AS TOTAL_ROOM_AREA,
  ROUND(SUM(AREA_NUM) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT FAC_ROOM_KEY), 0), 2) AS AVG_ROOM_SIZE
FROM base
GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY, FLOOR WITH ROLLUP
HAVING NOT (GROUPING(BUILDING_KEY) = 0 AND GROUPING(FLOOR) = 1 AND BUILDING_KEY IS NULL)
ORDER BY
  (BUILDING_KEY IS NULL) ASC,
  BUILDING_KEY,
  (FLOOR IS NULL) ASC,
  FLOOR;

WITH cs_lists AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
  JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ed
    ON ed.MIT_ID = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID
  WHERE ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE 'Computer Science%'
),
list_owner_counts AS (
  SELECT
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    mlo.OWNER_TYPE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT mlo.OWNER) AS owner_count
  FROM cs_lists cl
  JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = cl.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  JOIN MOIRA_LIST ml
    ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  JOIN MOIRA_LIST_OWNER mlo
    ON mlo.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
  GROUP BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, mlo.OWNER_TYPE
),
list_subscriber_counts AS (
  SELECT
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID) AS subscriber_count
  FROM cs_lists cl
  JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = cl.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  JOIN MOIRA_LIST ml
    ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  GROUP BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN GROUPING(loc.OWNER_TYPE) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL'
    ELSE loc.OWNER_TYPE
  END AS OWNER_TYPE,
  CASE
    WHEN GROUPING(loc.OWNER_TYPE) = 0 AND GROUPING(loc.MOIRA_LIST_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL'
    WHEN GROUPING(loc.OWNER_TYPE) = 1 AND GROUPING(loc.MOIRA_LIST_NAME) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL'
    ELSE loc.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
  END AS MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  SUM(loc.owner_count) AS owner_count,
  SUM(loc.subscriber_count) AS subscriber_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    loc.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    loc.OWNER_TYPE,
    loc.owner_count,
    lsc.subscriber_count
  FROM list_owner_counts loc
  JOIN list_subscriber_counts lsc
    ON lsc.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = loc.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
) loc
GROUP BY loc.OWNER_TYPE, loc.MOIRA_LIST_NAME WITH ROLLUP;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AS category_key,
    c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AS category_name,
    d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY AS session_key,
    d.MAX_ENROLLMENT AS max_enrollment,
    d.TERM_CODE AS term_code,
    sp.SPONSOR_NAME AS sponsor_name,
    ss.SESSION_START_TIME AS session_start_time
  FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d
  JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c
    ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
  LEFT JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR sp
    ON sp.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
  LEFT JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION ss
    ON ss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
),
cat_core AS (
  SELECT
    category_key,
    category_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT session_key) AS sessions_offered,
    SUM(COALESCE(max_enrollment, 0)) AS total_available_seats,
    MIN(term_code) AS first_term,
    MAX(term_code) AS most_recent_term
  FROM base
  GROUP BY category_key, category_name
),
cat_sponsor_mode AS (
  SELECT category_key, sponsor_name
  FROM (
    SELECT
      category_key,
      sponsor_name,
      COUNT(*) AS cnt,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY category_key
        ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, sponsor_name
      ) AS rn
    FROM base
    WHERE sponsor_name IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY category_key, sponsor_name
  ) x
  WHERE rn = 1
),
cat_start_time_mode AS (
  SELECT category_key, session_start_time
  FROM (
    SELECT
      category_key,
      session_start_time,
      COUNT(*) AS cnt,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY category_key
        ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, session_start_time
      ) AS rn
    FROM base
    WHERE session_start_time IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY category_key, session_start_time
  ) x
  WHERE rn = 1
),
overall_sponsor_mode AS (
  SELECT sponsor_name
  FROM (
    SELECT
      sponsor_name,
      COUNT(*) AS cnt,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, sponsor_name) AS rn
    FROM base
    WHERE sponsor_name IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY sponsor_name
  ) x
  WHERE rn = 1
),
overall_start_time_mode AS (
  SELECT session_start_time
  FROM (
    SELECT
      session_start_time,
      COUNT(*) AS cnt,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, session_start_time) AS rn
    FROM base
    WHERE session_start_time IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY session_start_time
  ) x
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
  cc.category_name AS subject_category,
  cc.sessions_offered,
  cc.total_available_seats,
  cc.first_term,
  cc.most_recent_term,
  csm.sponsor_name AS most_common_sponsor,
  ctm.session_start_time AS most_common_start_time
FROM cat_core cc
LEFT JOIN cat_sponsor_mode csm
  ON csm.category_key = cc.category_key
LEFT JOIN cat_start_time_mode ctm
  ON ctm.category_key = cc.category_key

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'OVERALL TOTAL' AS subject_category,
  COUNT(DISTINCT session_key) AS sessions_offered,
  SUM(COALESCE(max_enrollment, 0)) AS total_available_seats,
  MIN(term_code) AS first_term,
  MAX(term_code) AS most_recent_term,
  (SELECT sponsor_name FROM overall_sponsor_mode) AS most_common_sponsor,
  (SELECT session_start_time FROM overall_start_time_mode) AS most_common_start_time
FROM base

ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN subject_category = 'OVERALL TOTAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  subject_category;

WITH
latest_bldg AS (
  SELECT h.*
  FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST h
  JOIN (
    SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, MAX(FISCAL_PERIOD) AS max_fiscal_period
    FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST
    GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  ) m
    ON m.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = h.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
   AND m.max_fiscal_period = h.FISCAL_PERIOD
),
base_buildings AS (
  SELECT
    lb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
    CASE
      WHEN UPPER(lb.BUILDING_TYPE) LIKE 'RESIDENT%' THEN 'RESIDENTIAL'
      ELSE COALESCE(lb.BUILDING_TYPE, 'UNKNOWN')
    END AS building_type_group,
    lb.EXT_GROSS_AREA
  FROM latest_bldg lb
  WHERE lb.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER IS NULL
     OR lb.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER = ''
     OR lb.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER = lb.BUILDING_NUMBER
),
emp_by_building AS (
  SELECT
    fr.BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ed.MIT_ID) AS employee_cnt
  FROM FAC_ROOMS fr
  JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ed
    ON ed.OFFICE_LOCATION = fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY
  GROUP BY fr.BUILDING_KEY
),
addr_by_building AS (
  SELECT
    fba.BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
    COUNT(
      DISTINCT CONCAT_WS(
        '|',
        COALESCE(b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS, ''),
        COALESCE(fba.CITY, ''),
        COALESCE(fba.STATE, ''),
        COALESCE(fba.POSTAL_CODE, '')
      )
    ) AS addr_cnt
  FROM FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba
  JOIN BUILDINGS b
    ON b.BUILDING_KEY = fba.BUILDING_KEY
  WHERE fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
  GROUP BY fba.BUILDING_KEY
),
per_building AS (
  SELECT
    bb.building_type_group,
    bb.building_key,
    bb.EXT_GROSS_AREA,
    COALESCE(eb.employee_cnt, 0) AS employee_cnt,
    COALESCE(ab.addr_cnt, 0) AS addr_cnt
  FROM base_buildings bb
  LEFT JOIN emp_by_building eb
    ON eb.building_key = bb.building_key
  LEFT JOIN addr_by_building ab
    ON ab.building_key = bb.building_key
)
SELECT
  building_type_group AS building_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT building_key) AS building_count,
  SUM(employee_cnt) AS employees_with_offices,
  SUM(addr_cnt) AS unique_street_city_state_zip_count,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(employee_cnt) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE SUM(EXT_GROSS_AREA) / SUM(employee_cnt)
  END AS avg_gross_sqft_per_employee
FROM per_building
GROUP BY building_type_group

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'TOTAL' AS building_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT building_key) AS building_count,
  SUM(employee_cnt) AS employees_with_offices,
  SUM(addr_cnt) AS unique_street_city_state_zip_count,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(employee_cnt) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE SUM(EXT_GROSS_AREA) / SUM(employee_cnt)
  END AS avg_gross_sqft_per_employee
FROM per_building
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN building_type = 'TOTAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  building_type;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    z.ACCESS_LEVEL AS access_level,
    su2.SPACE_USAGE AS usage_type,
    COALESCE(fo.DLC_NAME, su.SPACE_UNIT) AS org_space_name,
    sd.BUILDING_ROOM,
    sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE
  FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd
  JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD z
    ON z.BUILDING_ROOM = sd.BUILDING_ROOM
   AND z.BUILDING_COMPONENT = sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT
  LEFT JOIN SPACE_USAGE su2
    ON su2.SPACE_USAGE = z.SPACE_USAGE
  LEFT JOIN SPACE_UNIT su
    ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = z.SPACE_UNIT_CODE
  LEFT JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo
    ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
  WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = '32'
    AND (z.SPACE_USAGE IS NULL OR UPPER(z.SPACE_USAGE) NOT LIKE '%STOR%')
    AND (su2.SPACE_USAGE IS NULL OR UPPER(su2.SPACE_USAGE) NOT LIKE '%STOR%')
),
detail AS (
  SELECT
    access_level,
    usage_type,
    org_space_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT BUILDING_ROOM) AS room_count,
    SUM(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS total_sqft,
    AVG(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS avg_sqft
  FROM base
  GROUP BY access_level, usage_type, org_space_name
),
usage_subtotal AS (
  SELECT
    access_level,
    usage_type,
    'SUBTOTAL' AS org_space_name,
    SUM(room_count) AS room_count,
    SUM(total_sqft) AS total_sqft,
    CASE WHEN SUM(room_count) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(total_sqft) / SUM(room_count) END AS avg_sqft
  FROM detail
  GROUP BY access_level, usage_type
),
access_subtotal AS (
  SELECT
    access_level,
    'SUBTOTAL' AS usage_type,
    'SUBTOTAL' AS org_space_name,
    SUM(room_count) AS room_count,
    SUM(total_sqft) AS total_sqft,
    CASE WHEN SUM(room_count) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(total_sqft) / SUM(room_count) END AS avg_sqft
  FROM detail
  GROUP BY access_level
),
overall_total AS (
  SELECT
    'TOTAL' AS access_level,
    'TOTAL' AS usage_type,
    'TOTAL' AS org_space_name,
    SUM(room_count) AS room_count,
    SUM(total_sqft) AS total_sqft,
    CASE WHEN SUM(room_count) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(total_sqft) / SUM(room_count) END AS avg_sqft
  FROM detail
)
SELECT
  access_level,
  usage_type,
  org_space_name,
  room_count,
  total_sqft,
  avg_sqft
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM detail
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM usage_subtotal
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM access_subtotal
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM overall_total
) x
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN access_level = 'TOTAL' THEN 3
    ELSE 1
  END,
  access_level,
  CASE
    WHEN usage_type = 'TOTAL' THEN 3
    WHEN usage_type = 'SUBTOTAL' THEN 2
    ELSE 1
  END,
  usage_type,
  CASE
    WHEN org_space_name IN ('TOTAL','SUBTOTAL') THEN 2
    ELSE 1
  END,
  org_space_name;
