WITH term_lengths AS (
  SELECT
    at1.TERM_CODE,
    at1.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    DATEDIFF(at1.TERM_END_DATE, at1.TERM_START_DATE) AS term_length_days
  FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at1
  WHERE at1.TERM_START_DATE IS NOT NULL
    AND at1.TERM_END_DATE IS NOT NULL
),
term_lengths_with_avg AS (
  SELECT
    tl.TERM_CODE,
    tl.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    tl.term_length_days,
    (
      SELECT AVG(tl2.term_length_days)
      FROM term_lengths tl2
      WHERE tl2.TERM_START_DATE IS NOT NULL
        AND tl2.TERM_END_DATE IS NOT NULL
        AND tl2.TERM_CODE IN (
          SELECT t3.TERM_CODE
          FROM (
            SELECT
              t2.TERM_CODE,
              ABS(DATEDIFF(at2.TERM_START_DATE, at.TERM_START_DATE)) AS start_date_distance
            FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at
            JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at2
              ON at2.TERM_START_DATE IS NOT NULL
             AND at2.TERM_END_DATE IS NOT NULL
            JOIN term_lengths t2
              ON t2.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE
            WHERE at.TERM_CODE = tl.TERM_CODE
            ORDER BY start_date_distance
            LIMIT 5
          ) t3
        )
    ) AS avg_nearby_term_length_days
  FROM term_lengths tl
)
SELECT
  c.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  c.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  t.term_length_days AS term_length_days,
  t.avg_nearby_term_length_days AS avg_nearby_term_length_days
FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
JOIN term_lengths_with_avg t
  ON t.TERM_CODE = c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r
  ON r.BUILDING_ROOM = c.MEET_PLACE
LEFT JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b
  ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
ORDER BY
  c.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  c.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  b.BUILDING_NAME;

WITH course_schedule AS (
  SELECT
    c.TERM_CODE,
    c.SUBJECT_ID,
    c.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    t.TERM_START_DATE,
    b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
    b.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME AS BUILDING_ACCESS_LEVEL,
    r.AREA AS ROOM_ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
    c.MEET_PLACE,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY c.TERM_CODE
      ORDER BY
        b.BUILDING_SORT,
        r.FLOOR,
        r.ROOM,
        c.SUBJECT_TITLE,
        c.SUBJECT_ID
    ) AS schedule_order
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
  JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t
    ON t.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE
  JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r
    ON r.BUILDING_ROOM = c.MEET_PLACE
  JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b
    ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
)
SELECT
  cs.SUBJECT_TITLE AS course_name,
  cs.TERM_START_DATE,
  cs.BUILDING_NAME_LONG AS building_name,
  cs.BUILDING_ACCESS_LEVEL,
  cs.ROOM_ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
  prev.SUBJECT_TITLE AS previous_course,
  next.SUBJECT_TITLE AS next_course
FROM course_schedule cs
LEFT JOIN course_schedule prev
  ON prev.TERM_CODE = cs.TERM_CODE
 AND prev.schedule_order = cs.schedule_order - 1
LEFT JOIN course_schedule next
  ON next.TERM_CODE = cs.TERM_CODE
 AND next.schedule_order = cs.schedule_order + 1
ORDER BY
  cs.TERM_CODE,
  cs.schedule_order;

WITH course_terms AS (
  SELECT
    c.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    c.SUBJECT_ID,
    c.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    c.MEET_PLACE,
    c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
    t.TERM_START_DATE
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
  JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t
    ON t.TERM_CODE = c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
),
course_buildings AS (
  SELECT
    ct.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    ct.SUBJECT_ID,
    ct.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    b.BUILDING_NAME,
    ct.TERM_CODE,
    ct.TERM_START_DATE

  LEFT JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r
    ON r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = ct.MEET_PLACE
  LEFT JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b

)
SELECT
  cb.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  cb.TERM_CODE,
  cb.TERM_START_DATE,
  cb.SUBJECT_ID,
  cb.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  cb.BUILDING_NAME,
  (

    FROM course_buildings cb2
    WHERE cb2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cb.ACADEMIC_YEAR

  ) AS courses_started_so_far_as_of_term_start
FROM course_buildings cb
ORDER BY
  cb.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  cb.TERM_START_DATE,
  cb.SUBJECT_ID;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    ss.CLUSTER_TYPE,
    at.IS_CURRENT_TERM,
    GREATEST(DATEDIFF(at.TERM_END_DATE, at.TERM_START_DATE) + 1, 0) AS term_length_days,
    ss.TOTAL_UNITS
  FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss
  JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at
    ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE
  WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Biology', 'Chemistry')
),
detail AS (
  SELECT
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    CLUSTER_TYPE,
    CASE WHEN IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'Current' ELSE 'Non-current' END AS term_status,
    COUNT(*) AS subject_count,
    AVG(term_length_days) AS avg_term_length_days,
    SUM(term_length_days) AS total_term_length_days,
    AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units,
    SUM(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units
  FROM base
  GROUP BY
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    CLUSTER_TYPE,
    CASE WHEN IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'Current' ELSE 'Non-current' END
),
group_totals AS (
  SELECT
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    'ALL' AS CLUSTER_TYPE,
    CASE WHEN IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'Current' ELSE 'Non-current' END AS term_status,
    COUNT(*) AS subject_count,
    AVG(term_length_days) AS avg_term_length_days,
    SUM(term_length_days) AS total_term_length_days,
    AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units,
    SUM(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units
  FROM base
  GROUP BY
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    CASE WHEN IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'Current' ELSE 'Non-current' END
),
overall_totals AS (
  SELECT
    'ALL' AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    'ALL' AS CLUSTER_TYPE,
    CASE WHEN IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'Current' ELSE 'Non-current' END AS term_status,
    COUNT(*) AS subject_count,
    AVG(term_length_days) AS avg_term_length_days,
    SUM(term_length_days) AS total_term_length_days,
    AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units,
    SUM(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units
  FROM base
  GROUP BY
    CASE WHEN IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'Current' ELSE 'Non-current' END
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    'ALL' AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    'ALL' AS CLUSTER_TYPE,
    'ALL' AS term_status,
    COUNT(*) AS subject_count,
    AVG(term_length_days) AS avg_term_length_days,
    SUM(term_length_days) AS total_term_length_days,
    AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units,
    SUM(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  CLUSTER_TYPE,
  term_status,
  subject_count,
  avg_term_length_days,
  total_term_length_days,
  avg_units,
  total_units
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM detail
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM group_totals
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM overall_totals
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM grand_total
) x
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  CASE WHEN CLUSTER_TYPE = 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  CLUSTER_TYPE,
  CASE term_status WHEN 'Current' THEN 0 WHEN 'Non-current' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department,
    CASE WHEN at.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'Current' ELSE 'Non-Current' END AS term_status,
    DATEDIFF(at.TERM_END_DATE, at.TERM_START_DATE) + 1 AS term_length_days,
    ss.TOTAL_UNITS AS total_units
  FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss
  JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at
    ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE
  JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so
    ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID
  WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Biology', 'Chemistry')
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    department,
    term_status,
    MAX(term_length_days) AS max_term_length_days,
    AVG(term_length_days) AS avg_term_length_days,
    MAX(total_units) AS max_units,
    AVG(total_units) AS avg_units
  FROM base
  GROUP BY department, term_status

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    department,
    'Subtotal' AS term_status,
    MAX(term_length_days) AS max_term_length_days,
    AVG(term_length_days) AS avg_term_length_days,
    MAX(total_units) AS max_units,
    AVG(total_units) AS avg_units
  FROM base
  GROUP BY department

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    'Overall Total' AS department,
    'Total' AS term_status,
    MAX(term_length_days) AS max_term_length_days,
    AVG(term_length_days) AS avg_term_length_days,
    MAX(total_units) AS max_units,
    AVG(total_units) AS avg_units
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  department,
  term_status,
  max_term_length_days,
  avg_term_length_days,
  max_units,
  avg_units
FROM agg
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN department = 'Overall Total' THEN 3
    WHEN term_status = 'Subtotal' THEN 2
    ELSE 1
  END,
  department,
  FIELD(term_status, 'Current', 'Non-Current', 'Subtotal', 'Total');

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS dept_name,
    tso.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER AS master_course_code,
    tso.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_id,
    tm.ISBN AS material_isbn,
    tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE AS new_shelf_price
  FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
  LEFT JOIN TIP_DETAIL td
    ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  LEFT JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
    ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
),
course_level AS (
  SELECT
    dept_name,
    master_course_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT subject_id) AS num_subjects,
    SUM(COALESCE(new_shelf_price, 0)) AS total_new_shelf_price,
    COUNT(DISTINCT material_isbn) AS unique_materials
  FROM base
  GROUP BY dept_name, master_course_code
),
dept_subtotal AS (
  SELECT
    dept_name,
    'ALL' AS master_course_code,
    SUM(num_subjects) AS num_subjects,
    SUM(total_new_shelf_price) AS total_new_shelf_price,
    SUM(unique_materials) AS unique_materials
  FROM course_level
  GROUP BY dept_name
),
overall_total AS (
  SELECT
    'ALL' AS dept_name,
    'ALL' AS master_course_code,
    SUM(num_subjects) AS num_subjects,
    SUM(total_new_shelf_price) AS total_new_shelf_price,
    SUM(unique_materials) AS unique_materials
  FROM course_level
)
SELECT
  dept_name,
  master_course_code,
  num_subjects,
  total_new_shelf_price,
  unique_materials
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM course_level
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM dept_subtotal
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM overall_total
) x
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN dept_name = 'ALL' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END,
  dept_name,
  CASE WHEN master_course_code = 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  master_course_code;

WITH course_base AS (
  SELECT
    c.TERM_CODE,
    c.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    c.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    c.SUBJECT_ID,
    CASE
      WHEN c.EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS IS NULL OR TRIM(c.EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS) = '' THEN 0
      ELSE 1 + (LENGTH(c.EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS) - LENGTH(REPLACE(c.EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS, ',', '')))
    END AS equiv_cnt
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
),
dept_dim AS (
  SELECT
    d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    d.SCHOOL_NAME,
    a.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER
  FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d
  LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a
    ON a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    cb.TERM_CODE,
    cb.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    cb.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    dd.SCHOOL_NAME,
    dd.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cb.SUBJECT_ID) AS courses_offered,
    AVG(cb.equiv_cnt) AS avg_equivalent_subjects_per_course
  FROM course_base cb
  LEFT JOIN dept_dim dd
    ON dd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cb.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  GROUP BY
    cb.TERM_CODE,
    cb.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    cb.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    dd.SCHOOL_NAME,
    dd.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER
),
term_totals AS (
  SELECT
    TERM_CODE,
    NULL AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    'TERM TOTAL' AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME,
    NULL AS DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER,
    SUM(courses_offered) AS courses_offered,
    SUM(avg_equivalent_subjects_per_course * courses_offered) / NULLIF(SUM(courses_offered), 0) AS avg_equivalent_subjects_per_course
  FROM agg
  GROUP BY TERM_CODE
),
overall_total AS (
  SELECT
    NULL AS TERM_CODE,
    NULL AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    'OVERALL TOTAL' AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME,
    NULL AS DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER,
    SUM(courses_offered) AS courses_offered,
    SUM(avg_equivalent_subjects_per_course * courses_offered) / NULLIF(SUM(courses_offered), 0) AS avg_equivalent_subjects_per_course
  FROM agg
)
SELECT
  TERM_CODE,
  DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  SCHOOL_NAME,
  DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER,
  courses_offered,
  avg_equivalent_subjects_per_course
FROM (
  SELECT
    TERM_CODE,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    SCHOOL_NAME,
    DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER,
    courses_offered,
    avg_equivalent_subjects_per_course,
    1 AS sort_group,
    TERM_CODE AS sort_term,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME AS sort_dept
  FROM agg

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    TERM_CODE,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    SCHOOL_NAME,
    DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER,
    courses_offered,
    avg_equivalent_subjects_per_course,
    2 AS sort_group,
    TERM_CODE AS sort_term,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME AS sort_dept
  FROM term_totals

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    TERM_CODE,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    SCHOOL_NAME,
    DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER,
    courses_offered,
    avg_equivalent_subjects_per_course,
    3 AS sort_group,
    'ZZZZZZ' AS sort_term,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME AS sort_dept
  FROM overall_total
) x
ORDER BY
  sort_term,
  sort_group,
  sort_dept;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN at.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'Current Term'
      ELSE 'Past Terms'
    END AS term_group,
    at.TERM_CODE,
    isc.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AS session_category,
    iss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY,
    CASE
      WHEN iss.SESSION_START_TIME IS NULL OR iss.SESSION_END_TIME IS NULL THEN NULL
      ELSE
        TIMESTAMPDIFF(
          MINUTE,
          STR_TO_DATE(iss.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p'),
          STR_TO_DATE(iss.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p')
        )
    END AS duration_minutes
  FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd
  JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at
    ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
  JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION iss
    ON isd.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = iss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
  JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY isc
    ON isd.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = isc.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
  WHERE at.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y'
     OR at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous'
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    term_group,
    session_category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS session_count,
    SUM(COALESCE(duration_minutes, 0)) AS total_minutes,
    AVG(duration_minutes) AS avg_minutes
  FROM base
  GROUP BY term_group, session_category

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    term_group,
    'Subtotal (All Categories)' AS session_category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS session_count,
    SUM(COALESCE(duration_minutes, 0)) AS total_minutes,
    AVG(duration_minutes) AS avg_minutes
  FROM base
  GROUP BY term_group

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    'Overall Total' AS term_group,
    'Subtotal (All Categories)' AS session_category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS session_count,
    SUM(COALESCE(duration_minutes, 0)) AS total_minutes,
    AVG(duration_minutes) AS avg_minutes
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  term_group,
  session_category,
  session_count,
  total_minutes,
  avg_minutes
FROM agg
ORDER BY
  CASE term_group
    WHEN 'Current Term' THEN 1
    WHEN 'Past Terms' THEN 2
    WHEN 'Overall Total' THEN 3
    ELSE 4
  END,
  CASE
    WHEN session_category = 'Subtotal (All Categories)' THEN 2
    ELSE 1
  END,
  session_category;

SELECT
  c.TERM_CODE AS term_code,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS distinct_subjects_offered
FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
GROUP BY c.TERM_CODE

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'ALL_TERMS' AS term_code,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS distinct_subjects_offered
FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c;

SELECT
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS list_name,
  mlo.OWNER AS owner,
  COUNT(DISTINCT mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS total_members
FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
  ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
LEFT JOIN MOIRA_LIST_OWNER mlo
  ON mlo.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
LEFT JOIN SE_PERSON sp
  ON sp.KRB_NAME = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER
LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd
  ON msd.FULL_NAME = sp.FULL_NAME
WHERE ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME LIKE 'E%'
GROUP BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, mlo.OWNER
HAVING
  COUNT(DISTINCT mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) BETWEEN 10 AND 20
  AND (
    SUM(CASE WHEN msd.DEPARTMENT = '6' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(DISTINCT mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER)
  ) >= 0.75;

WITH student_lists AS (
  SELECT
    s.FULL_NAME,
    s.DEPARTMENT,
    d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY s
  JOIN SE_PERSON p
    ON p.FULL_NAME = s.FULL_NAME
  JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL d
    ON d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID = p.MIT_ID
  WHERE s.LAST_NAME LIKE 'K%'
),
list_sizes AS (
  SELECT
    MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    COUNT(*) AS list_member_count
  FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL
  GROUP BY MOIRA_LIST_KEY
)
SELECT
  sl.FULL_NAME AS student_name,
  sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone_number,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sl.MOIRA_LIST_KEY) AS mailing_list_count,
  AVG(ls.list_member_count) AS avg_people_on_those_lists
FROM student_lists sl
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
  ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sl.DEPARTMENT
JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad
  ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
JOIN list_sizes ls
  ON ls.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = sl.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
GROUP BY
  sl.FULL_NAME,
  sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER
ORDER BY
  sl.FULL_NAME;

WITH list_counts AS (
  SELECT
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    ml.IS_PUBLIC,
    COUNT(*) AS total_subscriber_count
  FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
  JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  WHERE ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y'
    AND ml.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y'
  GROUP BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, ml.IS_PUBLIC
),
top_lists AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM list_counts
  ORDER BY total_subscriber_count DESC
  LIMIT 100
),
student_dept_counts AS (
  SELECT
    tl.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    msd.DEPARTMENT AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    COUNT(*) AS student_subscriber_count
  FROM top_lists tl
  JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = tl.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd
    ON msd.FULL_NAME = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME
  GROUP BY tl.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, msd.DEPARTMENT
),
ranked_depts AS (
  SELECT
    sdc.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY sdc.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
      ORDER BY sdc.student_subscriber_count DESC, sdc.DEPARTMENT_CODE
    ) AS rn
  FROM student_dept_counts sdc
)
SELECT
  tl.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS mailing_list_name,
  tl.IS_PUBLIC AS is_public,
  tl.total_subscriber_count,
  sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS top_student_department,
  rd.student_subscriber_count AS top_student_department_count
FROM top_lists tl
LEFT JOIN ranked_depts rd
  ON rd.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = tl.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
 AND rd.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
  ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = rd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
ORDER BY tl.total_subscriber_count DESC, tl.MOIRA_LIST_NAME;

SELECT
  b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  COALESCE(f.total_assignable_area, 0) AS total_assignable_area,
  COALESCE(f.total_non_assignable_area, 0) AS total_non_assignable_area,
  COALESCE(r.total_rooms, 0) AS total_rooms
FROM FAC_BUILDING b
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    SUM(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_assignable_area,
    SUM(NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_non_assignable_area
  FROM FAC_FLOOR
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
) f
  ON f.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT FAC_ROOM_KEY) AS total_rooms
  FROM FAC_ROOMS
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
) r
  ON r.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
ORDER BY total_assignable_area DESC;

SELECT
  r.ROOM_FULL_NAME AS room_name,
  mu.MAJOR_USE AS major_use,
  o.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization,
  COUNT(r.FAC_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count,
  SUM(CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS total_room_area,
  MAX(CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS largest_room_area
FROM FAC_ROOMS r
LEFT JOIN FAC_MAJOR_USE mu
  ON r.MAJOR_USE_KEY = mu.MAJOR_USE_KEY
LEFT JOIN FAC_ORGANIZATION o
  ON r.ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.ORGANIZATION_KEY
WHERE r.BUILDING_KEY = '45'
GROUP BY
  r.ROOM_FULL_NAME,
  mu.MAJOR_USE,
  o.ORGANIZATION_NAME
ORDER BY
  total_room_area DESC,
  room_count DESC,
  room_name;

SELECT
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  b.BUILDING_NUMBER AS building_number,
  b.DATE_BUILT AS construction_date,
  b.BUILDING_TYPE AS building_type,
  b.EXT_GROSS_AREA AS gross_area,
  COALESCE(a.address_count, 0) AS address_count,
  COALESCE(r.room_count, 0) AS room_count
FROM FAC_BUILDING b
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT BUILDING_ADDRESS_KEY) AS address_count
  FROM FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
) a
  ON a.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT FAC_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count
  FROM FAC_ROOMS
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
) r
  ON r.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
ORDER BY b.BUILDING_NUMBER;

SELECT
  lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(lso.TERM_CODE, ':', lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, ':', lso.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER)) AS courses_with_reserves,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lrc.CATALOG_TITLE) AS distinct_reserve_titles,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME) AS distinct_instructors
FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso
JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
  ON lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
  ON lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci
  ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
ORDER BY courses_with_reserves DESC, distinct_reserve_titles DESC, distinct_instructors DESC, department;

SELECT
  lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY,
  lso.SUBJECT_ID,
  lso.COURSE_NUMBER,
  lso.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lrrd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS items_on_reserve,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS) AS distinct_statuses
FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso
JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrrd
  ON lrrd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS AS lms
  ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
GROUP BY
  lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY,
  lso.SUBJECT_ID,
  lso.COURSE_NUMBER,
  lso.SUBJECT_TITLE;

SELECT
  lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME AS instructor_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lci.COURSE_NAME) AS courses_taught,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, ':', lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY)) AS reserve_materials_assigned,
  AVG(
    CASE
      WHEN lrc.CATALOG_YEAR REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$' AND CAST(lrc.CATALOG_YEAR AS UNSIGNED) > 0
        THEN CAST(lrc.CATALOG_YEAR AS UNSIGNED)
      ELSE NULL
    END
  ) AS avg_publication_year,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS) AS distinct_material_statuses
FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci
LEFT JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
  ON lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
LEFT JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
  ON lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
LEFT JOIN LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS lms
  ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
GROUP BY lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME
ORDER BY lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME;

SELECT
  rc.CATALOG_YEAR AS publication_year,
  COUNT(DISTINCT rc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserve_item_count,
  AVG(CHAR_LENGTH(rc.CATALOG_TITLE)) AS avg_title_length,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS) AS distinct_status_type_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ci.COURSE_NAME) AS distinct_course_count
FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL rmd
JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG rc
  ON rc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = rmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS ms
  ON ms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = rmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR ci
  ON ci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = rmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
GROUP BY rc.CATALOG_YEAR
ORDER BY rc.CATALOG_YEAR;

SELECT
  c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AS category_name,
  s.SPONSOR_NAME AS sponsor_name,
  COUNT(*) AS activity_count,
  AVG(d.FEE) AS avg_fee
FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d

GROUP BY
  c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME,
  s.SPONSOR_NAME
ORDER BY
  c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME,
  s.SPONSOR_NAME;

SELECT
  s.SPONSOR_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sess.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS session_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS unique_subject_count
FROM IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR s

  s.SPONSOR_NAME

  s.SPONSOR_NAME;

SELECT
  p.PERSON_ROLE AS role,
  c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AS category_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY) AS people_count,
  AVG(d.FEE) AS avg_fee

GROUP BY
  p.PERSON_ROLE,
  c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME

  p.PERSON_ROLE,
  c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME;

SELECT
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.LEVEL_ID) AS floor_count
FROM FAC_BUILDING b

  ON r.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN FAC_FLOOR f
  ON f.FLOOR_KEY = r.FLOOR_KEY

ORDER BY floor_count DESC;

SELECT
  c.PRINT_SUBJECT_ID AS subject_id,
  c.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title,
  COUNT(DISTINCT e.MIT_ID) AS different_responsible_instructors,
  MAX(CHAR_LENGTH(e.FULL_NAME)) AS longest_instructor_name_length

WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_SUMMER_TERM = 'Y'
GROUP BY
  c.PRINT_SUBJECT_ID,
  c.SUBJECT_TITLE;

SELECT
  o.OWNER AS owner,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y' THEN l.MOIRA_LIST_KEY END) AS mailing_list_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS member_count
FROM MOIRA_LIST_OWNER o
LEFT JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL d
  ON d.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = o.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY

  ON l.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
WHERE o.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = 'LIST69.377-keeper-xenon'
GROUP BY o.OWNER;

SELECT
  d.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cd.COURSE) AS total_courses,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' THEN cd.COURSE END) AS degree_granting_courses

JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d
  ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
GROUP BY d.SCHOOL_NAME
ORDER BY d.SCHOOL_NAME;

SELECT
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
  ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone_number,
  COUNT(msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS) AS student_count,
  MAX(CHAR_LENGTH(msd.FULL_NAME)) AS longest_student_name_length
FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d
LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad
  ON ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd
  ON msd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
GROUP BY
  d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER
ORDER BY
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
